technical_issues.issue: Abstract is slightly over the ~150-word target (~165 words), a minor format deviation.

overall: An outstanding report: clearly structured, well-researched with strong quantitative case evidence, balanced for/against arguments, a defensible decision rule, and stakeholder-specific recommendations. Minor word-count overshoot in the abstract only.

feedback.summary: An outstanding report. You identified several ethical issues and linked them clearly to engineering design, addressed both organisational context and stakeholder interests (Table 1), built balanced for/against arguments with rebuttals, and gave stakeholder-specific recommendations. Your evidence base is strong: eight reputable references and four external case studies with quantitative data (e.g., 81/236 NHS trusts, US$4.3B). Your structure and Figure 1 support the conclusion effectively. Only a minor format deviation: the abstract slightly exceeds the ~150-word target.
next_steps: Trim the abstract to ~150 words by cutting background detail and keeping only purpose, method of argument, and conclusion.
Consider adding one more visual element type (e.g., a stakeholder-influence matrix) to further strengthen the discussion section.
In future work, push the 'against' arguments even further by quantifying the cost of delay, so both sides carry equal evidential weight.
